_doc: Named counts that docs may quote with <!-- count:NAME -->N<!-- /count -->. check_doc_counts.py re-computes each one and flags a doc whose number has drifted. A count is either a glob (files or dirs matched, relative to the repo root) or a command (argv list, no shell) plus a regex whose first group is the number. Add a count here before quoting it in a doc.
